subject: CAIQ operator guide & evidence onboarding for KMS-backed private deployment
messages:
From: Chris Nguyen <cnguyen@acadiahealth.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: security@acadiahealth.com
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ — KMS and private deployment control artifacts request

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this on. Acadia is finalizing scope for a security review of Redwood's private deployment option (we'll be deploying a private instance in our VPC with customer-managed KMS keys). Our compliance team needs a CAIQ response package focused on controls related to key management (CSA sections: IAM, Cryptography, and Data Protection) plus sample evidence for runtime log capture and key rotation.

Can you provide:
- CAIQ answers for the controls called out below (we will only ask those in scope)
- A short operator guide (1–2 pages) describing how Redwood's private control plane integrates with a customer KMS/HSM (key rotation, access policies, emergency key revocation)
- Representative artifacts (log snippet, rotation schedule screenshot, admin role list) we can include in our control pack

Deadline: 2026-04-23 (we're presenting to auditors that week). If we need to redact anything, flag it and we'll coordinate.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call if helpful.

Regards,
Chris Nguyen\Security Engineer | Acadia Health
attachments: none

Hi Chris — thanks for the clear scope. We'll assemble a focused CAIQ response set and operator-facing evidence bundle for the KMS-backed private deployment. Proposed plan:

1) Kimberly will draft the CAIQ control responses for cryptography and key lifecycle controls; she'll include definitive statements and where we point to redacted artifacts.
2) Priya will collate runtime evidence (log snippets, sysadmin role lists, rotation records) and produce the 1–2 page operator guide targeted at your platform ops.
3) I'll review the bundle for redaction and legal/compliance sign-off, then upload to the Drive link and share a DocuSign/transfer link if needed.

Timeline: we'll circulate a first cut by 2026-04-18 and finalize by 2026-04-22 to meet your 04-23 presentation. If that works, I'll proceed and loop in any additional owners.

Quick clarifying Q: are you seeking HSM attestation screenshots (Y/N)? If yes, please confirm the vendor (e.g., AWS CloudHSM, Thales).

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Security Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
